<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/sites/{siteId}/evaluate"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Runs the detector over every forward pick face of the site now and raises
the requests it finds. It is a sweep that converges: a pick face that
already has an open request is reported as `alreadyOpen` and left alone,
so running it twice raises nothing the second time. Requires an
`Idempotency-Key`; replaying the same key returns the original summary.
